seoTitle: How to Delete Your eBay Account and Close It in 2026
metaDescription: Learn how to permanently close your eBay account in 2026, handle pending payments and open cases first, and back up your data before it's gone.
intro: Whether you're stepping away from buying, selling, or moving to another platform, closing an eBay account permanently takes a few deliberate steps rather than a single button press. This guide walks through requesting closure on both desktop and mobile, clearing anything that could block the request, and knowing what happens to your data afterward.

steps.heading: Resolve open items first
steps.body: Before eBay will process a closure request, clear any pending payments, unresolved cases, or active listings tied to your account. Leaving these open is one of the most common reasons a deletion request gets stuck.

steps.heading: Back up anything you want to keep
steps.body: Once your account is closed, your purchase history, saved searches, and messages are no longer accessible. Save any receipts, order details, or seller communications you might need later.

steps.heading: Request account closure
steps.body: From the account settings menu on desktop, or the equivalent settings screen in the mobile app, find the option to close or permanently delete your account and follow the confirmation prompts.

steps.heading: Confirm and wait for processing
steps.body: eBay doesn't erase your account instantly — it goes through a confirmation and processing window. During this time, avoid creating a new account with the same email until the old one is fully removed.

faq.question: Can I undo an eBay account deletion?
faq.answer: Once the closure is confirmed and processed, eBay does not offer a way to reverse it, so make sure you no longer need any account data before confirming.

faq.question: What happens to my order history when I delete my account?
faq.answer: Your transaction history and saved data are removed as part of the closure, which is why backing up receipts and messages beforehand is important.

faq.question: Can I close my eBay account if I have a pending sale?
faq.answer: No, you'll need to resolve pending payments and any open buyer or seller cases before eBay will let the closure go through.

faq.question: Is deleting my eBay account the same on mobile and desktop?
faq.answer: The steps are similar but found in slightly different menus — the tutorial covers both the desktop site and the mobile app so you can use whichever you prefer.
